card.name: Words before a quality or state description
card.fires_on: Small words and intensifiers like very, extremely, less, regular, in or a, right before an adjective or state about performance, resource use or upkeep. Mostly in tech and computing web text.

modes.label: Intensifiers before an adjective
modes.description: Degree words such as very, extremely or less placed before a quality like draining, good or efficient.
modes.example: will be<< extremely>> draining on your system resources

modes.label: Words leading into a maintenance or state phrase
modes.description: Short words in instructions or system descriptions, just before the thing being kept up or the state held.
modes.example: Windows 8 tries to keep the CPU<< in>> a low power state when it is idle

modes.label: Range gap before a number
modes.description: The space after a range start like 2 to, before the final number.
modes.example: It can be kept in a cool box for about 2 to<< >>3 days.

card.writes: It slightly pushes toward words about stability, with little else that is clear.
card.plain: It fires on little linking words before a description of how well a system runs or how steady it stays.
